sections.title: Similar and different
sections.content: hasonló ("similar") and különböző ("different") work as ordinary adjectives — right before a noun, or after van/vannak as a description, exactly like every other adjective you know.

items.english: The two colleagues are very different.

sections.content: hasonlóak takes the plural -k because it's describing more than one person (Anna és Károly) — the same plural-adjective agreement you already use everywhere else.
